name: CompareSlider
description:
Two pieces of content over each other with a divider between them: a before and after of an
image, a chart, a page. Drag the divider, press anywhere to move it there, or focus it and use
the arrow keys (Shift, Page Up and Page Down for ten percent, Home and End for the ends).
`before` starts at the reading start, so the sides change places in right-to-left languages and
the arrows still move the divider the way they point. The two contents are laid over each
other, and the taller decides the height. Controls inside them keep working.
signature: ({ before, after, value: valueProp, defaultValue, onValueChange, orientation, beforeLabel, afterLabel, step, disabled, "aria-label": ariaLabel, locale: localeProp, className, }: CompareSliderProps): import("react").JSX.Element

props.name: after
props.description: Shown from the divider to the reading end (or the bottom). Keep it the same size as `before`.

props.name: afterLabel
props.description: A short name over the `after` side.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: The divider's accessible name. Default "Comparison position".

props.name: before
props.description: Shown from the reading start (or the top) up to the divider. Any content: an image, a chart, text.

props.name: beforeLabel
props.description: A short name over the `before` side: "Before", "2024".

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The starting position when uncontrolled. Default 50.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables interaction while retaining the component’s disabled appearance.

props.name: locale
props.description: Formatting and wording locale; defaults to the nearest LocaleProvider.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the percentage when a drag is released, on a press and on each key. A drag writes the position directly until then.

props.name: orientation
props.description: Which way the divider travels. Default `horizontal`.

props.name: step
props.description: Percent per arrow key. Default 1; Shift, Page Up and Page Down take ten.

props.name: value
props.description: How much of `before` shows, from 0 to 100 percent. Pair with `onValueChange` to control it.
